title: Decision: draft-mahy-mls-new-content-types-02 is track-only for mimid
description:
Assay mimid-1wgh.44.17 of /home/mark/PROJECT/IETF/specs/draft-mahy-mls-new-content-types-02.txt (504 lines, read whole; sha256 in specs/PROVENANCE).

What it is: two MLS content types, status(4) and ephemeral(5), each with its own secret-tree ratchet (§4 Figure 1), negotiated by supported_content_types (LN, 0x000F) and required_content_types (GC, 0x0010); a new MLS Content Types registry (§7.2). Receivers and the DS may drop stale ones without decrypting (§4, §5). For presence and typing indicators. Unrelated to mls-extensions-11 content_media_types (media types inside application data).

How it meets mimid: a PrivateMessage with content type 4 or 5 does not decode in mimid (mimi-mls wire ContentType has only application, proposal, commit: crates/mimi-mls/src/wire/rfc9420.rs:551-558; OpenMLS likewise), so the hub refuses it at submitMessage. If adopted: OpenMLS fork work in the key schedule and framing, the hub's submit path accepting the new types (and optionally dropping stale ephemeral fanout per §5), and JMAP typing/presence mapping (JMAP Chat has its own typing events).

RECOMMEND: track only. mimid has no typing or presence over MIMI; the cost is a fork of OpenMLS's key schedule. No conflict today (no peer sends these).
